The PLASMA Act (H.R. 6465/S.4741) is a step in the right direction, ensuring life-saving plasma-derived medicines are accessible to over 125K U.S. patients. But let's be real—Congress loves complex subsidy games that protect Big Pharma's profits while taxpayers get the bill. 

This bill phases discounts over 7 years, delaying $55M+ in savings. Instead of streamlining Medicare, it adds more red tape. And while CMS covers some treatments, this bill expands subsidies without tackling why U.S. costs are 3-6X higher than abroad. 

Until Congress cuts the graft, even "patient-focused" bills risk being Big Pharma giveaways.
